experiment: N2 supplied mesh parser amendment A2
reason: The first office2 structural PLY read failed because the archive uses polygon faces (quads), whereas A1 assumed triangles. No cross-view or mesh-distance QA result was produced by that failed run.

changes.structural_faces: Accept polygon faces with at least three valid vertex indices; record arity counts.
changes.derived_triangle_reference: Keep source mesh unchanged. Fan-triangulate each face [v0,v1,...,vn] in its stored order as [v0,vi,vi+1], preserving winding. Store vertices and triangle indices in a separate NPZ.
changes.final_test: Same deterministic format conversion and structural validation only; no geometric residual or model evaluation.

unchanged: GT-only cross-view QA pairs and thresholds
interpretation: A parser/schema correction. Fan triangulation is a fixed conversion of the supplied polygon reference, not learned mesh completion or a reconstruction-quality result.
